4. **Calculate \(N_{\text{right}}(S)\):**
   - For \(0 \leq S \leq 9\): \(N_{\text{right}}(S) = S + 1\)
   - For \(10 \leq S \leq 18\): \(N_{\text{right}}(S) = 19 - S\)

5. **Sum the Products:**
   - Compute the product \(N_{\text{left}}(S) \times N_{\text{right}}(S)\) for each \(S\) from 1 to 18.
